- test files: passed / failed / total
- tests: passed / failed / skipped / total

- every failing test's name and its assertion output, if any

- total wall-clock duration

Context you need: this session added `scripts/capture-codex.mjs` (UNTRACKED, new) and amended `agent-deck-spec.md` (which lives in `lab/` and is reached through a symlink at the repo root). No `src/` or `webview/` runtime file was changed. `src/release/readme.test.ts` was run alone earlier this session and reported 53 passed — I want the full-suite number, independently measured, not a confirmation of that.

Do not modify any file. Report numbers only.
